title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $π_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.
tldr: ResWAM introduces visual residual learning for world-action models, predicting only feature changes rather than full future frames, which improves policy learning efficiency and performance on simulation and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: ResWAM 提出视觉残差学习方法，仅预测未来帧的特征变化而非完整帧，从而提高世界动作模型的策略学习效率和性能，在仿真和真实机器人任务中表现优异。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过未来预测增强视觉-语言-动作策略（VLAs），使策略能够预判其动作对物理世界的影响。现有WAMs对完整的未来观测进行监督，然而，在动作片段内观测通常变化甚微，因此未来损失主要被静态背景内容的复制所主导，而非学习与任务相关的机器人和物体运动，从而限制了策略学习。此外，现有WAMs依赖大规模视频生成模型或独立的 world models，导致训练和推理计算开销沉重，阻碍了闭环部署。为提升策略性能，我们提出视觉残差学习，在冻结的 DINOv3 空间中仅监督当前帧到未来帧的特征变化。与完整的未来特征相比，该残差学习目标产生更高的特征秩，蕴含更丰富、更多样化的场景变化表示，并在空间上集中于机械臂和被操作物体，而非背景。为进一步提升计算效率，我们提出 ResWAM，一个总参数量为 2.3B 的残差世界动作模型，其中包含一个轻量级 0.5B 双分支 DiT，通过条件流匹配联合训练动作分支和残差分支。在不进行机器人预训练（即不利用基准演示之外的机器人动作轨迹进行预训练）的情况下，ResWAM 在 LIBERO-Plus（81.1%）、RoboTwin 2.0（93.8%）和 RoboDojo（成功率 9.40%，得分 13.41）上以最低的训练（2.7-4.0 TFLOPs）和推理计算量（1.0-1.4 TFLOPs）取得最高平均成功率，并在真实机器人 Open、Put 和 Stack 任务中以 92.7 ms 延迟取得领先表现（平均 80.0%，较 π₀.₅ 提升 10.0%）。

title: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
summary: Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent. We present PanDWM, which stitches them into one $360^\circ$ panoramic band. Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. Conditioned on layouts, a causal student generates the band window by window in four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own rollouts. A feed-forward decoder lifts each frame along these rays into 3D Gaussians, and static Gaussians from neighbouring frames complete them into 4D scenes. On nuScenes, scored in one stitched $360^\circ$ view, PanDWM has lower FID and FVD than the multi-camera baselines at $8$-$46\times$ their speed, and keeps its 50-step teacher's FID while lowering FVD by 22-25%.
tldr: PanDWM stitches multi-camera driving video into a single 360-degree panoramic band, and trains a causal student world model distilled from a teacher to generate consistent 4D driving scenes more efficiently. It improves FVD over multi-camera baselines on nuScenes while being 8-46x faster.
tldr_zh: PanDWM将多相机驾驶视频拼接成360度全景带，并训练从教师模型蒸馏出的因果学生世界模型，以更高效地生成一致的4D驾驶场景。在nuScenes上相比多相机基线降低了FVD，同时速度提升8-46倍。
summary_zh: 驾驶世界模型通常从六个具有独立光学中心和较小重叠区域的针孔摄像头生成视频，并且必须学习保持这些视图的一致性。我们提出了PanDWM，它将这六个视图拼接成一个$360^\circ$全景带。摄像头边界随后落在一张图像内部，因此保持视图一致就意味着保持图像连续，同时每个像素仍然记录其对应的摄像头光线。在布局条件的约束下，一个因果学生模型以四步窗口方式逐窗口生成该全景带；它从因果教师模型中蒸馏得到，并在自身的展开轨迹上进行训练。一个前馈解码器将每一帧沿这些光线提升为3D高斯体，相邻帧的静态高斯体将它们补全为4D场景。在nuScenes数据集上，以拼接后的单一$360^\circ$视图进行评分，PanDWM的FID和FVD均低于多摄像头基线方法，同时速度是其$8$至$46$倍，并且在保持其50步教师模型FID的同时，将FVD降低了22-25%。

title: Cleanly-DINO: Efficiently Learning Visual Task Spaces for Robotics
summary: Learning manipulation tasks from few demonstrations requires abstractions that capture the changes relevant to task completion, such as object poses in rigid-body manipulation. However, tasks such as cleaning are defined by changes in visual state rather than object pose, making the choice of task representation less clear. In this work, we propose Cleanly-DINO to learn visual task spaces from few demonstrations. Given a mask of a task-relevant region and frozen ViT features, Cleanly-DINO fits a projection to isolate a task space and fit a progression metric to it. We train the model on diverse cleaning examples and evaluate its ability to localize incomplete task regions and transfer across visual domains. We also study its utility for robot learning by using it as an observation encoder and reward signal in a reinforcement learning setting. Finally, we deploy our fitted model within a real-world robotic wiping pipeline to evaluate its use in guiding task execution.
authors: José Arce y de la Borbolla
tldr: Cleanly-DINO learns visual task spaces from few demonstrations for cleaning tasks, fitting a projection onto frozen ViT features to isolate task-relevant progress, and is evaluated as a reward signal for RL and deployed in a real-world robotic wiping pipeline.
tldr_zh: Cleanly-DINO 从少量演示中学习清洁任务的视觉任务空间，通过将冻结的 ViT 特征投影到任务相关区域来拟合进度度量，并作为奖励信号用于强化学习及真实机器人擦拭任务。
summary_zh: 从少量示范中学习操控任务，需要抽象出与任务完成相关的状态变化，例如刚体操控中的物体位姿。然而，诸如清洁等任务是由视觉状态的变化而非物体位姿来定义的，这使得任务表示的选择变得不那么明确。在本工作中，我们提出Cleanly-DINO，用于从少量示范中学习视觉任务空间。给定任务相关区域的掩码和冻结的ViT特征，Cleanly-DINO拟合一个投影以隔离任务空间，并对其拟合一个进度度量。我们在多样化的清洁示例上训练该模型，并评估其在定位未完成任务区域及跨视觉域迁移方面的能力。我们还通过将其用作强化学习设置中的观测编码器和奖励信号，研究其在机器人学习中的实用性。最后，我们在真实世界的机器人擦拭流程中部署所拟合的模型，以评估其在指导任务执行中的应用。

title: SAFER: Navigating the Exploration-Exploitation Dilemma in World-Model-Based Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: An autonomous vehicle must foresee the consequences of its actions, especially in the rare, time-critical situations where crashes happen. A world model offers this foresight, but only within the coverage of its training data, which poses an exploration-exploitation dilemma. Within this coverage a planner can hardly improve on the data, and beyond it the model's errors mislead it. Logs of competent driving rarely contain the failures that would widen the coverage, and agents that learn from interaction gain them only by failing themselves, without being shown what to do instead. We propose SAFER, a framework that learns offline from failures that others make, judged by an expert, and keeps learning online from its own driving. Offline, partially trained agents and scripted, recoverable perturbations Stage failures in simulation, and an expert Annotates every visited state with its action and value, so that much of what the planner explores is covered before it drives. In planning, a chunked latent world model Foresees the consequences fast enough for real-time use, and a risk-aware sampling-based planner Evaluates candidate maneuvers by their return minus a bounded collision penalty. Online, a loop continuously Refines the model wherever this driving leaves the coverage of the offline data. In closed-loop evaluation against the compared methods, SAFER reaches the highest route completion and reward per step on the CARLA Leaderboard routes, 0.95 and 0.77 from a privileged bird's-eye view, and the highest episode reward in MetaDrive, 53.4 in regular and 49.0 in safety-critical traffic. Project page: https://ys-qu.github.io/safer-website.
tldr: SAFER is a framework for world-model-based planning in autonomous driving that addresses the exploration-exploitation dilemma by learning offline from staged failures and annotating states with expert actions and values, then refining the model online. It uses a chunked latent world model and risk-aware sampling-based planner, achieving state-of-the-art route completion and reward in CARLA and MetaDrive benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SAFER 是一个用于自动驾驶中基于世界模型规划的新框架，通过离线从 staged failures 中学习并用专家行为和价值注释状态，再在线细化模型，来解决探索-利用困境。它使用分块潜在世界模型和风险感知的基于采样的规划器，在 CARLA 和 MetaDrive 基准测试中取得了最先进的路线完成率和奖励。
summary_zh: 自主驾驶车辆必须预见其行为带来的后果，尤其是在发生碰撞的罕见、时间紧迫的关键情境中。世界模型提供了这种预见能力，但其适用范围仅限于训练数据所覆盖的范围，这带来了探索与利用之间的两难困境。在该覆盖范围内，规划器难以在数据基础上有所改进；而超出覆盖范围，模型的误差又会误导规划器。称职驾驶的日志中很少包含能够扩大覆盖范围的失败案例，而通过交互学习的智能体只能通过自身犯错来获得这些失败经验，却未被展示应如何正确应对。我们提出SAFER框架，该框架离线学习他人所犯的、经专家评判的失败案例，并在线持续从自身驾驶中学习。离线阶段，部分训练的智能体和脚本化的可恢复扰动在仿真中构建失败场景，专家对每个访问到的状态标注其动作和价值，从而在规划器投入驾驶前，大部分探索范围已获覆盖。在规划阶段，分块潜世界模型快速预见后果以满足实时需求，基于风险感知的采样规划器通过“回报减去有界碰撞惩罚”来评估候选操作。在线阶段，一个闭环持续在驾驶偏离离线数据覆盖范围处精化模型。在与对比方法的闭环评估中，SAFER在CARLA Leaderboard路线上取得了最高的路线完成率和每步奖励，分别为0.95和0.77（基于特权鸟瞰视角），并在MetaDrive中取得了最高的回合奖励，常规交通下为53.4，安全关键交通下为49.0。项目页面：https://ys-qu.github.io/safer-website。

title: EgoSwarm: Learning Decentralized Robot Swarm Intelligence from Human Swarm Demonstrations
summary: Advancing from individual embodied intelligence to swarm embodied intelligence is a key step toward scalable, general-purpose embodied intelligence. Complex tasks often require multiple agents to divide responsibilities, coordinate handovers, and manipulate shared objects collaboratively. However, existing robot learning methods rely primarily on individual demonstrations, which provide limited supervision for modeling dependencies among agent actions, while collecting multi-robot demonstrations at scale remains difficult. Human egocentric demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, yet distributed observations from multiple participants cannot directly supervise decentralized policies. We introduce EgoSwarm, the first robot learning framework for learning decentralized multi-robot collaboration from human swarm demonstrations. EgoSwarm collects more than 50 hours of collaborative experience using a robot-free multi-person egocentric system. We introduce the Swarm Interaction Packet (SIP) and Swarm Interaction Token (SIT) to recover cross-agent interaction relations from distributed observations and transform this experience into local supervision consistent with deployment-time information constraints. We further propose SwarmVLA, which transfers knowledge of swarm behavior to decentralized policies conditioned on local observations, local history, and limited neighbor messages. SwarmVLA achieves a mean success rate of 72.2% across three categories of multi-robot collaborative tasks. Project page:https://xitong-c.github.io/EgoSwarm_Page/.
tldr: EgoSwarm introduces a framework for learning decentralized multi-robot collaboration from human swarm demonstrations, using Swarm Interaction Packets (SIP) and Tokens (SIT) to recover cross-agent interactions and a SwarmVLA policy for local observation-conditioned control, achieving 72.2% success on collaborative tasks.
tldr_zh: EgoSwarm提出了一种从人类群体演示中学习去中心化多机器人协作的框架，利用群体交互包（SIP）和群体交互令牌（SIT）恢复跨智能体交互，并训练局部观测条件下的SwarmVLA策略，在协作任务中平均成功率72.2%。
summary_zh: 从单体具身智能迈向群具身智能，是通向可扩展、通用具身智能的关键一步。复杂任务往往需要多个智能体分工协作、协调交接，并共同操作共享物体。然而，现有的机器人学习方法主要依赖单体示范，难以提供足够的监督信息来建模智能体间的动作依赖关系，而大规模采集多机器人示范数据又十分困难。人类自我中心视角的示范提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但来自多个参与者的分布式观测无法直接监督去中心化策略。我们提出了EgoSwarm，这是首个从人类群体示范中学习去中心化多机器人协作的机器人学习框架。EgoSwarm利用无机器人多人在第一人称视角系统采集了超过50小时的协作经验。我们引入了群体交互数据包（SIP）和群体交互令牌（SIT），以从分布式观测中恢复跨智能体的交互关系，并将这些经验转化为与部署时信息约束一致的局部监督信号。我们进一步提出了SwarmVLA，将群体行为知识迁移到以局部观测、局部历史和有限邻居消息为条件的去中心化策略中。SwarmVLA在三类多机器人协作任务中实现了72.2%的平均成功率。项目页面：https://xitong-c.github.io/EgoSwarm_Page/。

title: ReactBench-AD: Do Driving VLAs and World-Action Models React to Imminent Hazards in Their Path?
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged in autonomous driving with the promise of strong generalization to long-tail scenarios. Although these models achieve state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving benchmarks, most existing benchmarks are dominated by nominal scenarios and therefore cannot test this promise. To test one such long-tail capability that is critical for safety, we introduce ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that measures how driving models react to objects that appear in the ego vehicle's path. Built on real NAVSIM and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles scenes, ReactBench-AD composites a crossing pedestrian, a standing pedestrian, or a stationary car consistently across all camera views and history frames. Each edited scene thus forms an exact, pixel-level counterfactual pair with its original, which allows us to isolate the causal effect of the inserted object on the predicted trajectory. Evaluating four VLAs and two WAMs, we find that they react weakly, often barely at all. Finally, we test how easily one of the evaluated VLAs, ReCogDrive, can be taught to brake hard for imminent hazards: a short fine-tuning stage on edited scenes substantially improves its reactions, with the learned behavior generalizing to unseen objects and fully real scenes, at minimal cost to nominal driving. These results call into question the out-of-the-box long-tail capabilities of these models, but suggest that they can be a strong foundation for acquiring them with little additional training, highlighting the value of real or synthetic data that demonstrates the long-tail behaviors nominal datasets rarely contain. Code and data will be made publicly available.
tldr: ReactBench-AD is a benchmark that inserts counterfactual imminent hazards into real driving scenes to test whether driving VLAs and World-Action Models react by braking, finding weak reactions but showing that short fine-tuning can substantially improve hazard response.
tldr_zh: ReactBench-AD 通过在真实驾驶场景中插入反事实的迫近危险来测试驾驶 VLA 和世界动作模型是否会刹车，发现模型反应薄弱，但短暂微调可显著提升其对危险的反应能力。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）和世界-动作模型（WAMs）已应用于自动驾驶领域，其优势在于对长尾场景具有强大的泛化能力。尽管这些模型在自动驾驶基准测试中取得了最先进的成绩，但现有的大多数基准测试以常规场景为主，无法真正检验这一能力。为了测试一项对安全至关重要的长尾能力，我们引入了ReactBench-AD，这是一个衡量驾驶模型对自车路径上出现的物体作出反应能力的基准。基于真实的NAVSIM和PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles场景，ReactBench-AD在所有相机视角和历史帧中一致地合成一个穿越的行人、一个站立的行人或一辆静止的车辆。因此，每个编辑后的场景与其原始场景构成一个精确的、像素级的反事实配对，使我们能够隔离插入物体对预测轨迹的因果影响。对四个VLA和两个WAM的评估结果显示，它们的反应普遍较弱，甚至几乎没有任何反应。最后，我们测试了所评估的VLA之一ReCogDrive，能否通过简单的训练学会对即将发生的危险进行紧急制动：在编辑场景上进行短暂微调后，该模型的反应显著改善，并且学习到的行为能够泛化到未见过的物体和完全真实的场景中，同时对常规驾驶的影响微乎其微。这些结果对这类模型开箱即用的长尾能力提出了质疑，但也表明它们可以作为以很少额外训练获得长尾能力的强大基础，凸显了展示长尾行为（常规数据集很少包含此类行为）的真实或合成数据的价值。代码和数据将公开发布。

title: PlanDiv: Test-Time Scaling with Latent Plans for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Test-time scaling improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies by drawing several action candidates and executing the best one. We find that its returns diminish quickly when the candidates are resampled from one decoder: they differ by noise rather than by plan, and for each of three resampling sources, going from four to eight candidates adds only 0.06-0.07 to the average number of completed tasks on CALVIN. We introduce PlanDiv, an action head that makes the candidates differ by plan: a lightweight planner proposes K latent plan hypotheses, a shared masked-diffusion executor decodes one action chunk per plan from a single backbone pass, and the policy executes the chunk that its own likelihood ranks highest. The plans are learned from demonstrations alone, without plan labels or rewards. With the backbone, data and training recipe held fixed, eight plan-conditioned candidates raise five-task chain success on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D from 56.9% to 69.9%, while eight candidates from autoregressive, plan-free or same-plan resampling reach at most 64.9%. The same-plan baseline is PlanDiv's own checkpoint with the plan held fixed, so this gap comes from the plans, not from drawing more samples. On LIBERO-Long, four plans remove 40% of single-candidate failures, against at most 21% for matched resampling. On a real Franka arm the gain appears where a task admits more than one solution: PlanDiv is on par with a single-output OpenVLA-OFT+ baseline on a one-solution task and succeeds in 51 of 54 trials against 40 of 54 on two tasks with two solutions.
tldr: PlanDiv improves test-time scaling for VLA models by introducing an action head that proposes diverse latent plan hypotheses, enabling plan-conditioned action candidates that outperform noise-based resampling across CALVIN, LIBERO, and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: PlanDiv 通过引入一种动作头来提出多样化的潜在计划假设，使计划条件下的动作候选优于基于噪声的重采样，在 CALVIN、LIBERO 和真实机器人任务上均取得更好表现。
summary_zh: 测试时扩展通过抽取多个动作候选并执行最优者来提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的性能。我们发现，当候选动作从同一解码器中重新采样时，其收益会迅速衰减：候选之间的差异来自噪声而非规划，并且在三种重采样来源中，从四个候选增加到八个候选，在CALVIN上平均完成的任务数仅增加0.06-0.07。我们提出PlanDiv，一种使候选动作在规划层面产生差异的动作头：一个轻量级规划器提出K个潜在规划假设，一个共享的掩码扩散执行器在单次骨干网络前向传播中为每个规划解码一个动作块，策略执行其自身似然排名最高的动作块。这些规划仅从演示中学习，无需规划标签或奖励。在骨干网络、数据和训练方案保持固定的条件下，八个规划条件候选将CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D上的五任务链式成功率从56.9%提升至69.9%，而来自自回归、无规划或同规划重采样的八个候选最多仅达到64.9%。同规划基线是PlanDiv自身检查点在规划固定时的表现，因此这一差距来自规划本身，而非采样数量的增加。在LIBERO-Long上，四个规划消除了40%的单候选失败，而匹配的重采样最多仅消除21%。在真实Franka机械臂上，增益出现在任务允许多种解决方案的场景中：在单一解决方案任务上，PlanDiv与单输出OpenVLA-OFT+基线表现相当；在两个具有两种解决方案的任务上，PlanDiv在54次试验中成功51次，而基线为54次中成功40次。

title: MoViC: Real-Time Humanoid Whole-Body Control from Monocular Video Streams
summary: Real-time whole-body imitation from monocular video requires both a robust universal tracker and high-quality real-time reconstruction. We present MoViC, a framework that uses live RGB video as a control signal for humanoid robots without wearable tracking devices. The framework combines monocular human motion reconstruction, robot retargeting, and a transformer-based behavior foundation model. The policy receives proprioceptive history, a single explicit next-step reference, and a compact frequency-domain motion representation that supplies temporal context without explicitly stacking future reference frames, which reduces the input dimension and network size. During deployment, our extrapolation method bridges the 10-Hz visual estimation with 50-Hz controller, enabling asynchronous visual processing and policy execution. Hardware experiments further demonstrate highly dynamic motion tracking and device-free teleoperation of bimanual and single-arm manipulation tasks from live monocular RGB input. Project page: https://movicproject.github.io/ .
tldr: MoViC is a framework for real-time whole-body control of humanoid robots from monocular video, combining monocular motion reconstruction, robot retargeting, and a transformer-based behavior foundation model, demonstrated in hardware experiments for dynamic tracking and device-free teleoperation.
tldr_zh: MoViC是一个从单目视频实时控制人形机器人全身的框架，结合了单目运动重建、机器人重定向和基于Transformer的行为基础模型，并在硬件实验中展示了动态跟踪和无设备遥操作。
summary_zh: 从单目视频中进行实时全身模仿需要同时具备强健的通用追踪器与高质量实时重建能力。我们提出了MoViC框架，该框架利用实时RGB视频作为人形机器人的控制信号，无需佩戴式追踪设备。该框架结合了单目人体运动重建、机器人重定向以及基于Transformer的行为基础模型。策略接收本体感觉历史、单一显式的下一步参考，以及一种紧凑的频域运动表示，该表示在无需显式堆叠未来参考帧的情况下提供时间上下文，从而降低了输入维度和网络规模。在部署阶段，我们的外推方法将10Hz的视觉估计与50Hz的控制器相衔接，实现了视觉处理与策略执行的异步运行。硬件实验进一步展示了从实时单目RGB输入进行高动态运动跟踪以及双臂和单臂操作任务的无设备遥操作。项目页面：https://movicproject.github.io/。

title: Practice Is Not Free: Measuring the Embodied Cost of Reset-Free Robot Practice
summary: When a robot practices without human resets, every attempt still costs wall-clock time, actuator wear, and sometimes a person's attention, yet the schedulers that decide what to practice next treat attempts as free. We present an open, low-cost testbed for measuring these costs: a self-built SO-101 arm runs two demonstration-trained ACT policies that reset each other, with a vision-based success detector and a ledger that records the time, joint travel, and human interventions of every attempt. We formulate cost-aware practice scheduling, in which task selection is rewarded by measured competence gain net of embodied cost, and specify in advance the comparison that will test it. Its first two conditions, run on hardware for 51 minutes of robot time, show that a fixed retry limit did not reduce the share of execution time lost to failures (36%, against 27% for a feasibility rule; not significant) and saved no robot time. The logs suggest why: failures showed no sign of clustering, so a retry right after a failure was as likely to succeed as any other attempt. The ledger also shows that most of the retry rule's extra human time came from cubes knocked out of reach rather than from the rule itself, and a cost-aware rule replayed on the logs recovers the sensible choice without a hand-set limit. We also report lessons from building the system, including a coverage effect in which concentrating demonstrations in a smaller workspace raised success there from 8/20 to 10/10.
tldr: This paper introduces a low-cost testbed for measuring the embodied costs of reset-free robot practice and evaluates cost-aware scheduling rules on a real robot arm, finding that fixed retry limits do not improve efficiency and that failures do not cluster.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于测量无重置机器人练习的具身成本的低成本测试平台，并在真实机器人臂上评估了成本感知调度规则，发现固定重试限制不能提高效率，且失败不会聚集。
summary_zh: 当机器人在没有人工重置的情况下进行练习时，每一次尝试仍然会消耗实际时间、造成执行器磨损，有时还需要人的关注，然而决定接下来练习什么的调度器却将尝试视为免费的。我们提出了一个开放、低成本的测试平台来衡量这些成本：一个自行搭建的SO-101机械臂运行两个经过演示训练的ACT策略，它们相互重置，并配备基于视觉的成功检测器以及一个台账，记录每一次尝试的时间、关节行程和人工干预。我们制定了成本感知的练习调度方案，其中任务选择以测得的胜任力增益减去具身成本作为奖励依据，并事先明确将要检验该方案的对比实验。其前两个条件在硬件上运行了51分钟的机器人时间，结果显示，固定的重试限制并未降低因失败而损失的执行时间比例（36%，而可行性规则为27%；差异不显著），也没有节省机器人时间。日志揭示了原因：失败没有表现出聚集迹象，因此失败后立即重试的成功概率与其他任何尝试相同。台账还显示，重试规则带来的额外人工时间大部分来自被撞出可及范围的立方体，而非规则本身；将一条成本感知规则在日志上回放，无需手动设定限制即可恢复合理的选择。我们还报告了构建该系统过程中的经验教训，包括一种覆盖效应：将演示集中在较小的操作空间内，使该空间内的成功率从8/20提高到10/10。

title: Value and Policy Calibration from Execution Feedback for Socially Compatible Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicle (AV) decisions at intersections affect the delay, braking, and motion smoothness of surrounding human-driven vehicles (HDVs). Learning socially compatible behavior requires connecting imagined interaction outcomes with feedback from executed actions. We propose a world-model reinforcement learning framework combines imagined policy improvement with direct value and policy calibration from finalized interactions, balancing AV progress with HDV interaction burden. An interaction-aware latent model supports imagination, while off-policy correction and replay updates enable observed rewards and transitions to supervise both the critic and actor. Simulation experiments at an unsignalized intersection achieve a 100% success and reductions in following-HDV acceleration variation of 65.5% and 44.0% relative to PIWM and DreamerV3, respectively. Ablations identify complementary roles for value calibration in reducing HDV burden and policy calibration in improving passage efficiency. Tests under out-of-distribution traffic shifts further show lower ego jerk and HDV acceleration variation than PIWM at comparable passage times.
tldr: This paper proposes a world-model reinforcement learning framework that calibrates value and policy from execution feedback to learn socially compatible driving behaviors at intersections, achieving high success rates and reduced HDV burden in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种世界模型强化学习框架，通过执行反馈校准价值和策略，以在交叉路口学习社会兼容驾驶行为，在仿真中实现了高成功率和降低HDV负担。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶车辆（AV）在路口的决策会影响周围人工驾驶车辆（HDVs）的延误、制动及行驶平顺性。学习具有社会兼容性的行为需要将设想的交互结果与实际执行动作后的反馈联系起来。我们提出了一种世界模型强化学习框架，将想象中的策略改进与来自最终交互的直接价值和策略校准相结合，从而在自动驾驶车辆通行效率与HDV交互负担之间取得平衡。该框架中的交互感知潜在模型支持想象过程，而离策略校正与回放更新则利用观测到的奖励和状态转移对评论家网络和行动者网络进行监督。在无信号交叉口的仿真实验中，该方法实现了100%的成功率，并且与PIWM和DreamerV3相比，跟驰HDV加速度变化分别降低了65.5%和44.0%。消融实验揭示了价值校正在减轻HDV负担及策略校正在提升通行效率方面的互补作用。在分布外交通流变化条件下的测试进一步表明，与PIWM相比，本方法在相近通行时间下实现了更低的自我车辆冲击度和HDV加速度变化。

title: Lao Siji: Adapting openpilot to Closed-Loop End-to-End Driving in Neural Reconstruction
summary: We present Lao Siji, an end-to-end driving policy that ranks third in the 2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge, ahead of most entries built on foundation models. Instead of training from scratch on a general-purpose vision backbone, we adapt openpilot, an open-source L2 production model. We freeze its vision encoder and fine-tune the policy layers with an ego-state adapter and a route memory. On closed-loop rollouts in neural-reconstructed scenes, we supervise the policy with a privileged map teacher for lateral self-correction and a body-extent loss for road and obstacle clearance, while distilling the base model's remaining outputs to retain car following. Ablations show that self-correction samples carry the gain, while the clearance loss substitutes for them where no teacher exists. Longitudinal safety instead rests on the base model's lead-vehicle estimate behind a rule-based speed layer. Longer training, imitating human logs, and human-log speed targets yield either no measurable gain or adverse effects. Without further training, Lao Siji also places among the leaders on HUGSIM and Odyssey. The final training takes only one GPU-hour and shifts the weights by 3.9% from the shipped model. Code will be released after review.
tldr: The paper presents Lao Siji, an end-to-end driving policy adapted from openpilot that ranks third in the NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge, using ego-state adapter, route memory, and a privileged map teacher for lateral self-correction, while retaining longitudinal safety via a rule-based speed layer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Lao Siji，一种基于openpilot改造的端到端驾驶策略，在NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E驾驶挑战赛中排名第三，通过自我校正训练和车身范围损失提升横向控制，纵向安全则由规则速度层保障。
summary_zh: 我们提出了“老司机”（Lao Siji），一种端到端驾驶策略，在2026年NVIDIA AlpaSim端到端驾驶挑战赛中排名第三，领先于大多数基于基础模型构建的参赛作品。我们并非在通用视觉骨干网络上从头训练，而是适配了openpilot——一个开源的L2级生产模型。我们冻结其视觉编码器，并通过自我状态适配器（ego-state adapter）和路线记忆（route memory）对策略层进行微调。在神经重建场景的闭环仿真测试中，我们利用特权地图教师模型（privileged map teacher）进行横向自校正，并通过车身范围损失函数（body-extent loss）确保道路与障碍物间的安全间距，同时蒸馏基础模型的其余输出以保持跟车能力。消融实验表明，自校正样本带来了性能提升，而在无教师模型存在的情况下，车身范围损失可替代其作用。纵向安全则依赖于基础模型的前车估计，并辅以基于规则的速度层。更长的训练时间、模仿人类日志以及使用人类日志中的速度目标，要么未带来可测量的提升，要么产生负面影响。无需额外训练，“老司机”在HUGSIM和Odyssey基准上也位居前列。最终训练仅消耗一个GPU小时，且相对于出厂模型的权重变化仅为3.9%。代码将在审阅后发布。

title: DiffWAM: Learning World Action Model from Consecutive Visual Difference
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as an important paradigm in robot learning, jointly predicting future scene states and robot actions from current observations and instructions. However, future states entangle task-related changes with large amounts of task-irrelevant content, such as static backgrounds, which weakens the model's ability to capture changes relevant to task execution. To address this, we propose Difference World Action Model (DiffWAM), a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances world representations by jointly learning future-state prediction and consecutive visual difference prediction. We define consecutive visual differences as differences between the latent representations of consecutive observations, providing an explicit learning signal for temporal variation. The framework comprises a World Expert for future frame prediction, an Action Expert for action generation, and a Diff Expert for predicting these latent differences along the trajectory. A structured unidirectional attention mask conditions the Diff, World, and Action Experts solely on the current-frame representation while blocking attention between experts. This design allows both the World and Diff Experts to be removed during inference, introducing no additional inference overhead. DiffWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks and substantially improves over FastWAM on real-world manipulation tasks. Specifically, it attains average success rates of 98.8%, 92.65%, and 88.3%, outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline (i.e., FastWAM) by 1.75, 1.55, and 15.0 percentage points, respectively.
tldr: DiffWAM introduces a Mixture-of-Experts world action model that jointly predicts future visual states, latent visual differences, and robot actions, improving task-relevant change capture and achieving state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks and real-world manipulation.
tldr_zh: DiffWAM 提出了一种基于混合专家的世界动作模型，通过联合预测未来视觉状态、潜在视觉差异和机器人动作，增强了任务相关变化的捕获能力，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 基准和真实世界操作任务中取得了最先进性能。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为机器人学习中的重要范式，能够根据当前观测和指令联合预测未来场景状态与机器人动作。然而，未来状态将任务相关变化与大量任务无关内容（如静态背景）纠缠在一起，削弱了模型捕捉与任务执行相关变化的能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出差分世界动作模型（DiffWAM），一种专家混合（MoE）框架，通过联合学习未来状态预测与连续视觉差分预测来增强世界表征。我们将连续视觉差分定义为相邻观测潜在表征之间的差异，为时间变化提供显式学习信号。该框架包含用于未来帧预测的世界专家、用于动作生成的动作专家，以及用于沿轨迹预测这些潜在差异的差分专家。一种结构化的单向注意力掩码使差分专家、世界专家和动作专家仅以当前帧表征为条件，同时阻断专家间的注意力流动。这一设计使得世界专家和差分专家在推理时均可被移除，不引入任何额外推理开销。DiffWAM在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0基准测试上取得了最先进的结果，并在真实世界操作任务上显著超越FastWAM。具体而言，其平均成功率分别达到98.8%、92.65%和88.3%，较最先进基线（即FastWAM）分别高出1.75、1.55和15.0个百分点。

title: JEPA4R: Embodied JEPA World Models with 4D Point Planning
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models predict future embeddings instead of pixels and plan in latent space. Two challenges remain: 2D images leave the metric geometry that manipulation acts on implicit and entangled with appearance, and what these models imagine stays hidden, as they are mostly judged in simulation by short-horizon latent planning. We present JEPA4R, a JEPA world model that observes single-depth-camera point clouds, predicts and plans in their latent space, and acts through a policy head on its frozen latents; we call this 4D point planning. A decoder on the frozen world model shows what it imagines as 4D point clouds, with a mean point error within 1.1 cm over 200 steps. Under the policy-learning protocols of OGBench and CortexBench, JEPA4R leads pixel JEPA models on OGBench Cube-Single, Cube-Double, Cube-Triple and Scene, and ranks first on MetaWorld and Adroit Relocate with 98.4% and 88.0%, above the runner-up, R3M, at 96.0% and 65.3%. Trained only in a digital twin, JEPA4R and its policy heads run zero-shot on the real arm with both a gripper and a dexterous hand.
tldr: JEPA4R is a JEPA world model that operates on single-depth-camera point clouds, predicts and plans in latent space, and generates 4D point cloud predictions. It outperforms pixel-based JEPA models on various benchmarks and demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for real robot manipulation with both a gripper and a dexterous hand.
tldr_zh: JEPA4R 是一种基于深度点云的 JEPA 世界模型，在潜空间中进行预测和规划，并生成 4D 点云预测。它在多个基准测试中优于基于像素的 JEPA 模型，并展示了在真实机器人上使用夹爪和灵巧手的零样本仿真到现实迁移能力。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型预测未来嵌入而非像素，并在潜在空间中进行规划。仍存在两个挑战：二维图像使得操作所依赖的度量几何变得隐式且与外观纠缠在一起，并且这些模型所想象的内容仍然不可见，因为它们大多在模拟中通过短时程潜在规划进行评估。我们提出了JEPA4R，一种JEPA世界模型，它观测单深度相机点云，在其潜在空间中进行预测和规划，并通过策略头在其冻结的潜在表示上执行动作；我们称之为4D点规划。冻结世界模型上的解码器将其想象的内容以4D点云的形式呈现，200步内的平均点误差在1.1厘米以内。在OGBench和CortexBench的策略学习协议下，JEPA4R在OGBench的Cube-Single、Cube-Double、Cube-Triple和Scene任务上领先于像素JEPA模型，并在MetaWorld和Adroit Relocate任务上以98.4%和88.0%的成绩排名第一，高于亚军R3M的96.0%和65.3%。仅在数字孪生环境中训练的JEPA4R及其策略头可在真实机械臂上以零样本方式运行，同时支持夹爪和灵巧手。

title: Early Readability of Trajectory Quality in Diffusion Driving Planners
summary: Diffusion-based driving planners can generate multiple trajectories for the same scene, but these candidates vary in quality. Can their internal states reveal which candidate will be better before denoising is complete? We systematically study this question in three pretrained planners: Alpamayo, ReCogDrive-IL, and HDP, using linear probes to predict final trajectory quality from intermediate states and evaluating candidate ranking and selection on held-out scenes. Across all three planners, we observe that states from the first denoiser evaluation already support informative selection, while further denoising does not consistently improve selection quality. Further analyses show that readout depends on the representation and reader, and that selection can coexist with limited overall ranking accuracy. These findings motivate an early-selection method that selects after the first denoiser evaluation and completes only the chosen candidate. This reduces computation relative to fully denoising every candidate and improves open-loop trajectory quality over random selection across all three planners. In particular, it reduces Alpamayo's average displacement error by 17.8% and 13.4% in one- and four-camera configurations, respectively. Closed-loop evaluations also show higher mean driving scores and progress.
tldr: This paper systematically studies whether internal states of diffusion-based driving planners can predict trajectory quality early in the denoising process, and proposes an early-selection method that reduces computation while improving closed-loop driving performance.
tldr_zh: 本文系统研究了扩散式驾驶规划器中间状态能否在去噪早期预测轨迹质量，并提出一种早期选择方法，在降低计算量的同时提升闭环驾驶性能。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的驾驶规划器能够为同一场景生成多条轨迹，但这些候选轨迹的质量参差不齐。在去噪完成之前，其内部状态是否能揭示哪条候选轨迹将更优？我们系统性地在三个预训练规划器中研究了这一问题：Alpamayo、ReCogDrive-IL和HDP，使用线性探针从中间状态预测最终轨迹质量，并在保留场景上评估候选排序与选择的表现。在全部三个规划器中，我们观察到首次去噪评估的状态已足以支持有信息量的选择，而进一步去噪并未持续提升选择质量。进一步分析表明，读取效果依赖于表示形式与读取器，且选择能力可以与整体排序精度有限的情况共存。这些发现促使我们提出一种早期选择方法——在首次去噪评估后即进行选择，仅对选中的候选轨迹完成后续去噪。相较于对每条候选轨迹进行完整去噪，该方法降低了计算量，并在全部三个规划器中相较于随机选择提升了开环轨迹质量。具体而言，在单摄像头和四摄像头配置下，Alpamayo的平均位移误差分别降低了17.8%和13.4%。闭环评估同样显示出更高的平均驾驶得分和行驶进度。

title: Beyond Vehicle-Centric Data: Scaling Autonomous Driving through Roadside-to-Vehicle Generation
summary: Training autonomous driving models requires large and diverse datasets, collected primarily by vehicles. Scaling them entails investment in fleet operation, data processing and annotation. Road infrastructure records traffic and multi-vehicle interactions, yet the viewpoint gap between roadside and onboard sensors limits its direct use for training. Here we introduce AnyR2V, a framework that transforms multimodal roadside observations into seven-camera surround-view videos for different vehicle perspectives. It aggregates sequential observations into a shared scene representation of geometry and road-user motion, then renders appearance, depth and layout conditions along target-vehicle trajectories. Supervised by spatiotemporally aligned roadside-vehicle pairs, AnyR2V generates surround-view videos guided by scene structure and road-user motion. Existing roadside 3D bounding boxes are transformed into target-vehicle coordinates and paired with generated images, allowing one traffic recording and its annotations to yield training data from multiple vehicle perspectives. We construct R2V360, a dataset of 89 real traffic sequences at an urban intersection, with aligned multimodal roadside data and onboard surround-view videos. AnyR2V outperforms six scene reconstruction methods in image fidelity and in depth and semantic agreement between generated and real onboard images. We further evaluate generated videos along other vehicles' trajectories by adding them to real training data. Adding generated frames equal to 50% of the original real training frame count improves mean average precision (mAP) by 3.3-3.4 AP-points across three 3D object detectors on the real onboard test set, relative to real-data-only baselines. These results demonstrate that roadside traffic records can provide training data from multiple vehicle perspectives, offering a new data source for autonomous driving.
tldr: AnyR2V transforms multimodal roadside observations into seven-camera surround-view videos from different vehicle perspectives, creating a new data source for training autonomous driving models that improves 3D object detection mAP by 3.3-3.4 points.
tldr_zh: AnyR2V 将多模态路侧观测转化为不同车辆视角的七摄像头环视视频，为训练自动驾驶模型提供新的数据来源，使 3D 目标检测 mAP 提升 3.3-3.4 个百分点。
summary_zh: 训练自动驾驶模型需要大规模且多样化的数据集，这些数据主要依靠车辆采集。扩大数据规模需投入大量资源用于车队运营、数据处理及标注。路侧基础设施能够记录交通状况及多车交互信息，然而路侧传感器与车载传感器之间的视角差异限制了其直接用于模型训练。为此，我们提出AnyR2V框架，可将多模态路侧观测数据转化为面向不同车辆视角的七摄像头环绕视图视频。该框架将时序观测聚合为统一的场景几何与道路使用者运动表示，进而沿目标车辆轨迹渲染外观、深度及布局条件。通过时空对齐的路侧-车辆数据对进行监督训练，AnyR2V能够依据场景结构及道路使用者运动信息生成环绕视图视频。已有的路侧3D边界框被转换至目标车辆坐标系，并与生成的图像配对，从而实现单次交通记录及其标注即可生成来自多个车辆视角的训练数据。我们构建了R2V360数据集，包含城市交叉口89段真实交通序列，并配有对齐的多模态路侧数据及车载环绕视图视频。在图像保真度以及生成图像与真实车载图像之间的深度和语义一致性方面，AnyR2V均优于六种场景重建方法。我们进一步将沿其他车辆轨迹生成的视频纳入真实训练数据进行评估。在真实车载测试集上，相对于仅使用真实数据的基线，增加相当于原始真实训练帧数50%的生成帧，可使三种3D目标检测器的平均精度（mAP）提升3.3-3.4个百分点。上述结果表明，路侧交通记录能够为自动驾驶提供来自多个车辆视角的训练数据，为自动驾驶开辟了新的数据来源。

title: Pros4D: Modeling Evolving 4D Worlds in Latent Space for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
summary: Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand how 3D environments evolve over time, supporting physical world understanding and embodied intelligence. Existing efforts primarily address observed-dynamics understanding, whereas agents in dynamic environments also require future-dynamics prediction beyond the observation boundary. Moreover, external geometric processing and textual descriptions can increase inference complexity or lose information when representing continuous dynamics. These limitations motivate a shared internal state that preserves observed dynamics and remains predictive beyond the input video. Accordingly, we present Pros4D, a framework for modeling evolving 4D worlds in latent space that unifies retrospective understanding of observed-dynamics with prospective reasoning for future-dynamics prediction. Specifically, Pros4D-Engine derives geometry-grounded supervision and constructs paired examples for both tasks, while Pros4D-Bench evaluates them across eight spatial task categories spanning dynamic cameras, objects, and scenes. At the model level, Pros4D compresses observed dynamics into latent observed states and autoregressively rolls them forward into latent future states. 4D Latent Alignment (4DLA) grounds these states through complementary visual-semantic and geometric supervision, while joint language supervision connects them to task reasoning. Experiments across benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines in both capabilities.
tldr: Pros4D introduces a latent-space framework for VLMs to model evolving 4D worlds, unifying retrospective understanding of observed dynamics with prospective prediction of future dynamics, and demonstrates consistent improvements across eight spatial task categories.
tldr_zh: Pros4D 提出了一种在潜在空间中建模动态4D世界的框架，统一了对已观察动态的回顾性理解与对未来动态的预测性推理，并在八个空间任务类别上取得了持续改进。
summary_zh: 从单目视频中进行动态空间推理，使视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够理解三维环境如何随时间演变，从而支持物理世界理解与具身智能。现有工作主要聚焦于对已观测动态的理解，而动态环境中的智能体还需超越观测边界，具备对未来动态的预测能力。此外，外部几何处理与文本描述在表达连续动态时，可能增加推理复杂度或造成信息损失。这些局限性促使我们构建一种共享的内部状态，既能保留已观测动态，又能超越输入视频进行预测。为此，我们提出Pros4D，一个在潜空间中建模演化四维世界的框架，将已观测动态的回溯性理解与未来动态预测的前瞻性推理统一起来。具体而言，Pros4D-Engine推导出几何引导的监督信号，并为上述两项任务构建配对样本；Pros4D-Bench则跨八个空间任务类别对其进行评估，覆盖动态相机、动态物体和动态场景。在模型层面，Pros4D将已观测动态压缩为潜空间观测状态，并通过自回归方式将其前推至潜空间未来状态。四维潜空间对齐（4DLA）通过互补的视觉-语义与几何监督对这些状态进行锚定，而联合语言监督则将其连接到任务推理。跨基准实验表明，在强基线模型之上，该框架在两项能力上均取得了一致的性能提升。

title: Prompt Re-Specification and Target-Mask Availability in Mask-Conditioned Visual Reinforcement Learning for Moving-Platform Landing
summary: Visual reinforcement learning (RL) policies that land a drone on a moving platform can fail when the landing pad looks different from the one used in training. Using binary target masks as the visual input removes most pixel-level appearance information while preserving the spatial representation of the target, and lets a text prompt specify the target. In simulation, we test whether a frozen (fixed-weight) mask-based DrQ-v2 policy can handle a new pad when only the prompt of its fine-tuned SAM 3 detector changes. A banana-themed pad lowered landing success from 75.6% to 12.0%, and SAM 3 rarely detected it under the original prompt. A revised prompt, chosen after testing several candidates, restored success to 68.4% with no weight updates. In a separate experiment with a policy trained on ground-truth masks, filling in masks that were missing while the pad was visible helped landing far more than the tested mask-centroid and area corrections. Tracking the pad over time supplied masks more often and also kept producing them after the pad was confirmed absent from the rendered image, but it did not establish a reliable improvement in landing success. Whether a usable mask reaches the policy at all thus appears to be an important limiting factor for this approach.
tldr: This paper investigates mask-conditioned visual reinforcement learning for drone landing on moving platforms, showing that updating the text prompt for a frozen SAM 3 detector can recover performance on unseen landing pads without weight updates, and that mask availability is a critical bottleneck.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了用于移动平台着陆的掩码条件视觉强化学习，表明仅更新冻结的 SAM 3 检测器的文本提示即可在无需权重更新的情况下恢复对未见着陆垫的性能，并指出掩码可用性是关键瓶颈。
summary_zh: 视觉强化学习（RL）策略在将无人机降落至移动平台时，若着陆平台外观与训练时所见不同，则可能导致策略失效。采用二值目标掩码作为视觉输入，可去除大部分像素级外观信息，同时保留目标的空间表征，并允许通过文本提示指定目标。在仿真环境中，我们测试了当仅改变其微调后的SAM 3检测器提示词时，基于冻结（固定权重）掩码的DrQ-v2策略能否适应新的着陆平台。结果显示，采用香蕉主题平台后，降落成功率由75.6%降至12.0%，且SAM 3在原始提示词下几乎无法检测到该平台。在测试多个候选提示词后，修订的提示词在无需更新权重的情况下将成功率恢复至68.4%。在另一项使用真实掩码训练的独立实验中，当平台可见但掩码缺失时，填充缺失掩码对降落性能的提升远大于所测试的掩码质心及面积修正方法。随时间推移持续跟踪平台可更频繁地提供掩码，并在平台已确认从渲染图像中消失后仍持续生成掩码，但并未实现可靠的降落成功率提升。因此，策略能否获得可用掩码似乎是该方法的一个重要限制因素。

title: AgenticJevNav: Agentic Object Search and Navigation via Event-Driven Verification
summary: Agentic navigation must maintain goals and adapt actions from incomplete evidence despite execution failures and delayed inference. We present AgenticJevNav, which links goal-directed planning, evidence memory, event-triggered verification, and bounded execution. The Agent plans from RGB, odometry, memory, and feedback, retaining goal ownership while authorizing a bounded action set. Jev reviews structured evidence after blocked/failed execution or two consecutive low-progress segments. Version, freshness, and once-only checks govern decision application. A single executor and independent RGB reflex constrain motion. Goal revisions revoke obsolete requests and actions before replanning. Across six simulated task families, AgenticJevNav achieves 73.33% SR over 60 trials, 21.67 percentage points above the next-best Agent-only aggregate control under differing historical protocols. A real-world GENISOM L1 quadruped deployment achieves 70.0% success over 30 trials, including bounded search reporting. Together, the simulation and physical-robot results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed architecture, while remaining failures highlight opportunities to improve grounding, approach planning, and runtime.
tldr: AgenticJevNav introduces an agentic architecture for object search and navigation on a quadruped robot, combining goal-directed planning, evidence memory, event-triggered verification, and bounded execution to handle execution failures and delayed inference, achieving 73.33% SR in simulation and 70% on a real robot.
tldr_zh: AgenticJevNav 提出了一种用于四足机器人的智能体目标搜索与导航架构，结合目标导向规划、证据记忆、事件触发验证和受限执行，以处理执行失败和延迟推理，在仿真中达到73.33%的成功率，实机达到70%。
summary_zh: 智能体导航必须在执行失败和推理延迟的情况下，依然保持目标并基于不完整证据调整行动。我们提出了AgenticJevNav，它将目标导向规划、证据记忆、事件触发验证和受限执行相结合。智能体基于RGB图像、里程计、记忆和反馈进行规划，在保留目标归属的同时授权一组受限动作集合。Jev在受阻/失败执行或连续两个低进展片段后审查结构化证据。版本检查、新鲜度检查和一次性检查共同约束决策的应用。单个执行器和独立的RGB反射机制约束运动。目标修订在重新规划前撤销过期请求和动作。在六个模拟任务族中，AgenticJevNav在60次试验中达到73.33%的成功率，在不同历史协议下比次优的纯智能体聚合对照组高出21.67个百分点。真实环境中的GENISOM L1四足机器人部署在30次试验中实现了70.0%的成功率，包括有界搜索报告。综上，仿真和实体机器人结果证明了所提出架构的有效性，而剩余失败则凸显了在基础能力提升、接近规划和运行时间方面的改进机会。

title: The Flip Test: Video World Models Fail to Learn the World State
summary: Video world models promise to predict the future of a scene from its present. Do current models keep this promise? We probe this question counterfactually. When a small change to the present flips the future, such as a box resting a few millimeters before or past a table edge, a model that tracks the state of the world must flip its prediction too. We build FlipTest, a three-level hierarchy of increasingly strict tests over 1,680 initial frames from 10 simulated and 15 real-world tasks. At the base, visual minimal pairs, two nearly identical frames whose true futures differ, test whether predictions change across the boundary; matched controls go further and test whether they change only where the future does; and dense sweeps, the strictest level, locate exactly where they change. All 11 video world models we evaluate fall short. The best averages 18.3% pair accuracy over real and simulated scenes, below the 25% of random guessing. Models flip as often on steps that leave the future unchanged as on steps that change it, and their response stays flat across the sweeps. On the same frames, a vision-language model is selective and traces a near S-shaped curve near the boundary, and a coding agent that measures the image comes close to the true boundary. This implies that the deciding information is in the frame, and video models just miss it. We therefore urge the community to rethink world modeling as pure video prediction. Next-frame prediction must do more than draw plausible pixels; it must also identify the causal states that control future dynamics.
tldr: This paper introduces FlipTest, a benchmark to evaluate whether video world models track the causal state of a scene, showing that all tested models fail to flip their predictions appropriately when the future changes due to small state differences. The findings question the adequacy of pure video prediction for world modeling and suggest that models must explicitly identify causal states.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了FlipTest基准，用于评估视频世界模型是否追踪场景的因果状态。结果显示所有测试的模型都无法在未来的微小状态变化时正确翻转其预测，这表明纯视频预测不足以构建真正的世界模型。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型承诺能够根据场景的当前状态预测其未来。当前模型是否兑现了这一承诺？我们通过反事实的方式对此进行探究。当对当前状态的一个微小改变翻转了未来，例如一个盒子恰好停在桌沿前几毫米或越过桌沿几毫米，一个追踪世界状态的模型也必须翻转其预测。我们构建了FlipTest，这是一个三级严格递增的测试体系，涵盖来自10个模拟任务和15个真实世界任务的1,680个初始帧。在基础层级，视觉最小对——即两幅几乎相同但其真实未来不同的帧——用于测试预测是否在边界处发生变化；匹配对照进一步测试预测是否仅在未来发生变化的地方变化；而密集扫描作为最严格的层级，精确定位预测变化的确切位置。我们评估的所有11个视频世界模型均未达标。表现最好的模型在真实和模拟场景中的平均配对准确率仅为18.3%，低于随机猜测的25%。模型在不会改变未来的步骤上与会改变未来的步骤上翻转的频率相当，并且其响应在扫描过程中保持平坦。在相同的帧上，视觉语言模型具有选择性，并在边界附近描绘出近乎S形的曲线，而一个测量图像的编码代理则接近真实边界。这表明决定性的信息就在帧中，而视频模型恰恰忽略了它。因此，我们敦促社区重新思考将世界建模视为纯视频预测的做法。下一帧预测必须做的不仅仅是绘制合理的像素；它还必须识别控制未来动态的因果状态。

title: Drone Navigation for Fast, Safe Emergency Response
summary: In 2025, there was a total of 358 weather-related disasters worldwide affecting millions of people. For unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to autonomously aid these people, they need to be able to navigate around complex obstacles and reach their destinations to deliver supplies or quickly locate survivors in disaster-stricken areas. Our research addresses this need by providing a method to compute minimum-time trajectories in real time while providing guarantees of obstacle avoidance along the trajectory. Previous approaches treat the problem of computing time-optimal trajectories without considering obstacle avoidance. Our work not only includes obstacle avoidance constraints, but also improves overall mission time for navigation. We define mission time as the sum of planning time and traversal time. In time-sensitive emergencies, rapid trajectory planning is essential to ensure the prompt delivery of critical medical aid. As such, we consider the combined planning and traversal time as the key metric for how quickly the vehicle can reach a survivor. We show a sample mission in Fig. 1 where the quadrotor navigates through multiple canyon-like obstacles to deliver aid; during most of this trajectory, it is applying the near-maximum thrust.
tldr: This paper proposes a real-time trajectory planning method for UAVs that ensures obstacle avoidance while minimizing combined planning and traversal mission time, demonstrated for emergency response scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种无人机实时轨迹规划方法，在保证避障的同时最小化规划与飞行总时间，并应用于应急救援场景。
summary_zh: 2025年，全球共发生358起与天气相关的灾害，影响了数百万人。为了使无人机能够自主援助这些受灾人群，它们需要能够绕过复杂障碍物并到达目的地，以运送物资或迅速定位灾区内的幸存者。我们的研究通过提供一种实时计算最小时间轨迹的方法，并确保沿轨迹的避障保障，满足了这一需求。以往的方法在计算时间最优轨迹时未考虑避障问题。我们的工作不仅纳入了避障约束，还改善了导航的整体任务时间。我们将任务时间定义为规划时间与行进时间之和。在时间紧迫的紧急情况下，快速进行轨迹规划对于确保关键医疗援助的及时送达至关重要。因此，我们将规划与行进时间的总和视为衡量飞行器到达幸存者速度的关键指标。我们在图1中展示了一个示例任务，其中四旋翼飞行器穿越多个类似峡谷的障碍物以运送援助物资；在该轨迹的大部分时间内，它均施加了接近最大推力的推力。

title: Recovery-Guided Model-Based Diffusion for Safety-Critical Legged Locomotion
summary: Safety-critical high-speed legged locomotion requires motion planners to balance safety foresight with online computational efficiency. Although short prediction horizons reduce rollout costs, they provide limited safety foresight, and strict safety constraints severely restrict the feasible trajectory space. We propose a recovery-guided model-based diffusion (MBD) framework for safety-critical legged locomotion. It incorporates a learned terminal recovery critic into short-horizon trajectory optimization. Specifically, the critic approximates the worst-case future clearance margin along rollouts of a designated recovery policy. We introduce a feasibility-guided refinement strategy that combines within-horizon constraints and terminal recoverability at each sampling stage, while retaining feasible elites to mitigate sampling-support loss. Across 50 paired randomized Unitree Go2 obstacle-avoidance trials, our approach achieves zero collisions and 98% strict-clearance success, while requiring substantially less computation than long-horizon MBD baselines. A project page is available at https://zack4417.github.io/rg-mbd/.
tldr: This paper proposes a recovery-guided model-based diffusion framework that integrates a learned terminal recovery critic into short-horizon trajectory optimization for safety-critical legged locomotion, achieving zero collisions and high success rates in real-world Unitree Go2 trials with lower computation than long-horizon baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种恢复引导的基于模型的扩散框架，将学习到的终端恢复评论器集成到短时域轨迹优化中，用于安全关键的腿部运动，在真实宇树Go2试验中实现了零碰撞和高成功率，且计算量低于长时域基线。
summary_zh: 安全攸关的高速腿式运动要求运动规划器在安全前瞻性与在线计算效率之间取得平衡。尽管较短预测时域可降低展开计算成本，但其提供的安全前瞻性有限，且严格的安全约束会严重压缩可行轨迹空间。为此，我们提出一种面向安全攸关腿式运动的恢复引导模型扩散（MBD）框架。该框架将学习得到的终端恢复评判器融入短时域轨迹优化中。具体而言，该评判器沿着指定恢复策略的展开轨迹近似最坏情况下的未来安全裕度。我们引入一种可行性引导的精炼策略，在每次采样阶段同时考虑时域内约束与终端可恢复性，同时保留可行精英样本以缓解采样支撑缺失问题。在50组配对随机的宇树Go2避障试验中，该方法实现了零碰撞及98%的严格安全裕度成功率，且计算量远低于长时域MBD基线方法。项目页面见 https://zack4417.github.io/rg-mbd/。

title: AlphaTruck: A Platform for High-Speed Off-Road Autonomy on Unstructured Terrain
summary: Progress in autonomous navigation in off-road environments requires not only advances in algorithms, but also robust and capable physical platforms suited to both development and deployment. Today, off-road autonomy is typically developed and tested at one of two extremes of vehicle scale, each with different drawbacks. Full-size vehicles are capable but expensive, require large logistic infrastructure for deployment and maintenance, and expensive when pushed beyond their limits. RC-scale vehicles are small and inexpensive, but limited in the terrain they can traverse and the payload that they can carry, which includes their sensors and compute. We present the AlphaTruck platform, which leverages recent advances in compact sensing and compute to integrate multimodal sensing, embedded CPU-GPU compute, and an onboard autonomy stack for high-speed, off-road navigation, all integrated into a large-scale, 1/5th RC vehicle chassis. AlphaTruck is designed as both a research testbed and a field-deployable platform for commercial and defense missions such as survey, search and rescue, and agriculture, with the capacity to carry task-specific payloads. At 1/5 scale, the autonomy stack, sensors, and batteries all compete for the same mass, power, and cooling budget, so the platform must balance five needs: mobility over rough terrain, rich sensing, onboard computation, payload capacity to carry the autonomy stack while leaving room for task-specific equipment, and practical operation and repair. Thus, AlphaTruck navigates off-road environments autonomously at 6-10 m/s using only onboard sensing and compute.
tldr: Presents AlphaTruck, a 1/5-scale RC-based autonomous off-road vehicle platform that integrates multimodal sensing, embedded compute, and an autonomy stack to achieve high-speed navigation at 6-10 m/s on unstructured terrain, serving as a research testbed and field-deployable platform.
tldr_zh: 提出了 AlphaTruck，一种基于 1/5 比例遥控车底盘的自主越野车辆平台，集成多模态感知、嵌入式计算和自主导航栈，在非结构化地形上以 6-10 米/秒的速度高速导航，既可作为研究试验台，也可作为可部署的野外作业平台。
summary_zh: 在越野环境自主导航方面的进展，不仅需要算法上的突破，还需具备坚固且能力强大的物理平台，以适应开发与部署的双重需求。当前，越野自主技术通常在两种极端规模的车载平台上进行开发与测试，这两种选择各有其局限性。全尺寸车辆功能全面但成本高昂，部署与维护需庞大的后勤支持，且在超出极限时费用不菲。而遥控模型车（RC级）虽小巧经济，却受限于可穿越的地形及承载能力，包括其搭载的传感器与计算设备。为此，我们推出了AlphaTruck平台，它利用紧凑型传感与计算领域的最新进展，集多模态感知、嵌入式CPU-GPU计算及车载自主导航系统于一体，专为高速越野导航设计，全部集成在一个1/5比例的遥控车底盘上。AlphaTruck既可作为研究测试平台，也是适用于商业及国防任务（如勘探、搜救、农业）的现场部署平台，具备搭载特定任务载荷的能力。在1/5比例下，自主导航系统、传感器及电池需共享有限的质量、功率及冷却资源，因此平台设计需兼顾五大需求：崎岖地形的机动性、丰富的感知能力、板载计算力、在携带自主导航系统的同时保留任务专用设备空间的载荷容量，以及操作的实用性与维护的便捷性。基于此，AlphaTruck能够仅凭借机载传感与计算，以6-10米/秒的速度在越野环境中实现自主导航。

title: Sim-to-Real Room-Mediated Object-Goal Navigation with ROS 2 and Nav2
summary: Although object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) approaches are usually evaluated in simulation, which offers scale and repeatable environments, real-world deployments are rarely examined beyond feasibility demonstrations. This paper presents the deployment of Room-Mediated Co-occurrence, an ObjectNav policy that reasons over Room Probability Vectors (RPVs), on two robotic platforms (Boston Dynamics Spot and Clearpath Robotics TurtleBot 4) through a robot-agnostic ROS 2 bridge. We study how these semantic priors generalise to physical environments and describe the adaptations required to transfer RPV from simulation to hardware, covering sensing, localisation, and the action interface. Across 66 trials on Spot, searching for 11 object categories from two starting positions in a university postgraduate research facility, RPV achieves a raw Success Rate (SR) of 0.455. Our analysis identifies undetected glass walls, entry into off-limits areas, limited usable depth range, target size, and mismatch between the room lexicon and physical layout as plausible contributors to the 8.4 percentage-point gap between the real-world SR and the reported simulated SR of 0.539. Code is available at https://github.com/Matthew-K-Chua/rpv-ros2-bridge.
tldr: This paper details the sim-to-real deployment of a Room-Mediated Co-occurrence ObjectNav policy on two real robots via a ROS 2 bridge, analyzing the performance gap and required adaptations.
tldr_zh: 本文详细介绍了通过ROS 2桥接在两种真实机器人上部署基于房间介导共现的物体目标导航策略，并分析了性能差距和所需的适应性调整。
summary_zh: 尽管目标导向导航（ObjectNav）方法通常在仿真环境中进行评估，这提供了规模化且可重复的实验场景，但其在真实世界中的部署往往仅停留在可行性示范层面。本文介绍了基于房间中介共现（Room-Mediated Co-occurrence）策略的部署，该策略利用房间概率向量（RPVs）进行推理，并通过一个与机器人无关的ROS 2桥接模块，在两个机器人平台（Boston Dynamics Spot和Clearpath Robotics TurtleBot 4）上实现。我们研究了这些语义先验如何泛化到物理环境，并描述了将RPV从仿真迁移到硬件所需的适应性调整，涵盖感知、定位及动作接口等方面。在Spot平台上进行的66次试验中，我们在某大学研究生研究设施内从两个起始位置搜索11类目标物体，RPV实现了0.455的原始成功率（SR）。我们的分析表明，未检测到的玻璃墙、进入禁区、可用的有效深度范围有限、目标尺寸以及房间词典与物理布局之间的不匹配，是导致真实世界成功率与仿真报告值0.539之间8.4个百分点差距的可能因素。代码可在 https://github.com/Matthew-K-Chua/rpv-ros2-bridge 获取。

title: Cache or Denoise Less? Residual Reuse in a Flow-Matching World Action Model
summary: Flow-matching robot policies generate each action chunk through repeated network evaluations, one per denoising step. Cross-cycle caches such as C$^3$ache reuse computation from earlier replanning calls, but whether they beat simply taking fewer steps is unclear. We compare the two in Fast-WAM, a 6B-parameter world action model, on LIBERO-Goal. Two uncached steps keep the success of ten: on all 500 initial states they are non-inferior within two percentage points, for one checkpoint and noise seed. Under PyTorch's default compile mode, they also cut a replanning call on an RTX A6000 from 202 to 92 ms. This leaves little room for caching. A cache that keeps two fresh steps cannot be faster than two uncached steps: every call still encodes the images, runs the video expert and computes those two steps. Caching the first of two steps, refreshed every fourth call, saves at most 11--14% of a call by our cost model. Cached policies are also fragile. Their losses tracked the share of the flow path the cached steps cover: under Fast-WAM's current time shift, C$^3$ache's eight cached steps cover 80% of the path instead of 44%, and the cached policy succeeds on 63% of states against 95% uncached. Resampling the noise on every call cost caches covering 60% or more of the path 14--40 points. These results argue for fewer-step baselines and for testing reuse under the deployed sampler and noise settings. We release our evaluation harness, logs and a checklist.
tldr: This paper compares caching versus fewer denoising steps in a flow-matching world action model, finding that two uncached steps match ten-step performance while being faster and more robust, questioning the value of cross-cycle caches.
tldr_zh: 本文在流匹配世界动作模型中比较了缓存与减少去噪步数，发现两步不缓存即可达到十步的性能，且更快更稳健，质疑了跨周期缓存的价值。
summary_zh: 摘要：流匹配机器人策略通过重复的网络评估生成每个动作块，每次去噪步骤各进行一次。跨周期的缓存（如C$^3$ache）复用了早期重新规划调用中的计算，但它们是否优于简单地减少步骤数尚不明确。我们在Fast-WAM（一个60亿参数的世界动作模型）上，针对LIBERO-Goal任务对两者进行了比较。两次未缓存的步骤保持了十次步骤的成功率：在所有500个初始状态下，对于一个检查点和噪声种子，其成功率不劣于后者，差距在两个百分点以内。在PyTorch默认的编译模式下，它们在RTX A6000上将一次重新规划调用从202毫秒缩短至92毫秒。这几乎没有给缓存留下空间。一个保留两个新步骤的缓存不可能比两次未缓存的步骤更快：每次调用仍需要编码图像、运行视频专家并计算这两个步骤。根据我们的成本模型，缓存这两个步骤中的第一步（每四次调用刷新一次）最多节省调用时间的11%–14%。缓存策略也很脆弱。它们的损失与缓存步骤所覆盖的流路径比例相关：在Fast-WAM当前的时间偏移下，C$^3$ache的八个缓存步骤覆盖了路径的80%而非44%，并且缓存策略在63%的状态上成功，而未缓存策略则为95%。每次调用重新采样噪声使得覆盖路径60%或以上的缓存损失了14–40个百分点的成功率。这些结果支持采用更少步骤的基线方法，并建议在部署的采样器和噪声设置下测试复用策略。我们发布了我们的评估框架、日志和检查清单。

title: Physics-Grounded STL Monitoring from Image Observations
summary: Robotic manipulation missions must satisfy timed and conditional requirements that can be expressed in signal temporal logic (STL). While a practical means of monitoring these requirements is from camera images, this is challenging because STL robustness depends on physical margins, such as distances and clearances, that are not directly observed. Rather than learning a separate visual monitor for each formula, we learn a shared latent representation from multi-view images and decode physically meaningful margins for individual predicates. Co-training the encoder with predicate decoders increases the certification rate from 58.7% to 96.3% compared with a frozen encoder, despite nearly unchanged predicate sign accuracy. STL semantics then compose these margins into robustness estimates for any bounded formula over the trained predicates, without retraining. We further calibrate the decoding errors of selected STL clauses using conformal prediction, yielding two-sided intervals that certify both satisfaction and violation and propagate through interval STL to any formula composed from the clauses. In simulated kitchen missions (LIBERO), our monitor correctly predicts satisfaction or violation in 98.9% of 4662 evaluations across 18 unseen formulas. For missions lasting up to 17 min, calibrated bounds establish satisfaction or violation for 96.9% of missions without incorrect conclusions. A single calibration also provides simultaneous 91.0% coverage across all 255 conjunctions of eight clauses, allowing new formulas without recalibration.
tldr: This paper introduces a physics-grounded STL monitoring framework that learns a shared latent representation from multi-view images to decode physical margins, enabling robust and calibrated satisfaction/violation certification for complex robotic manipulation missions without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于物理的STL监控框架，从多视角图像中学习共享潜在表示并解码物理裕度，从而无需重新训练即可对复杂机器人操作任务进行鲁棒且经过校准的满足/违反认证。
summary_zh: 机器人操作任务必须满足可用信号时序逻辑（STL）表达的定时及条件性要求。虽然从摄像头图像中监控这些要求是一种实用手段，但这一任务颇具挑战性，因为STL鲁棒性依赖于诸如距离和间隙等物理裕度，而这些裕度无法直接观测。我们并非为每条公式单独学习一个视觉监控器，而是从多视角图像中学习一个共享的潜在表征，并为各个谓词解码出具有物理意义的裕度。与冻结编码器相比，将编码器与谓词解码器进行联合训练可使认证率从58.7%提升至96.3%，尽管谓词符号准确性几乎保持不变。随后，STL语义将这些裕度组合成针对所训练谓词上任意有界公式的鲁棒性估计，而无需重新训练。我们进一步利用保形预测对所选STL子句的解码误差进行校准，从而生成能够同时认证满足与违反的双侧区间，并通过区间STL传播至由这些子句构成的任意公式。在模拟厨房任务（LIBERO）中，我们的监控器在18个未见公式的4662次评估中，准确预测满足或违反的比例达98.9%。对于持续长达17分钟的任务，校准后的边界可在96.9%的任务中确立满足或违反状态，且不产生错误结论。单次校准还能在八个子句的全部255个合取式上同时实现91.0%的覆盖率，从而允许在不重新校准的情况下使用新公式。

title: Toward Planning Representations That Separate Task Structure from Visual Content
summary: Effective planning requires representations that preserve task-relevant geometry and object identity while ignoring visual variation that does not alter the task. Existing evaluations of visual generalization often change several factors simultaneously, making the source of a failure difficult to identify. We introduce a controlled evaluation of object-goal navigation (ObjectNav), the task of reaching an instance of a named object category, in procedurally generated ProcTHOR houses. Training and evaluation houses share floor plans, object locations, goals, and start states, while visual factors are changed individually or in combination. Across model-free reinforcement learning (RL), model-based RL, and agents using frozen pretrained visual representations, our results show that appearance changes impair navigation, but their effects differ sharply by factor. Surface material changes account for most of the average change in success, whereas clutter and lighting have little effect. The magnitude of a global image statistics shift does not reliably predict performance: changing only the goal object's appearance can substantially impair an end-to-end agent despite a small image-level change. We found that a model based agent that plans over frozen features from the pretrained DINOv2 image encoder achieves the highest success (0.83) under the full shift, but remains sensitive to surface appearance. Our experiments reveal an important requirement for planning representations: they must separate invariant spatial task structure from appearance.
tldr: This paper introduces a controlled ObjectNav evaluation in ProcTHOR, varying visual factors independently, and finds that surface material changes most impair navigation, with a DINOv2-based model-based agent achieving the highest success but still sensitive to appearance, highlighting the need for planning representations that separate task structure from visual content.
tldr_zh: 本文在ProcTHOR中引入了受控的物体目标导航评估，独立改变视觉因素，发现表面材质变化对导航影响最大，基于DINOv2的模型基代理成功率最高但仍对表观敏感，强调了规划表示需要分离任务结构与视觉内容。
summary_zh: 有效规划需要能够保留任务相关几何结构和物体身份的表征，同时忽略不改变任务的视觉变化。现有的视觉泛化评估往往同时改变多个因素，导致难以定位失败的具体原因。我们引入了一种在程序化生成的ProcTHOR房屋中对物体目标导航（ObjectNav）任务——即到达指定物体类别实例——进行受控评估的方法。训练和评估所用房屋共享平面布局、物体位置、目标和起始状态，而视觉因素则单独或组合地改变。在无模型强化学习（RL）、基于模型的RL以及使用冻结预训练视觉表征的智能体上，我们的结果表明，外观变化会损害导航性能，但其影响因因素不同而差异显著。表面材质变化占平均成功率变化的大部分，而杂乱程度和光照影响较小。全局图像统计量变化的大小并不能可靠预测性能：仅改变目标物体的外观，即使图像级变化很小，也可能大幅削弱端到端智能体的表现。我们发现，基于模型的智能体在冻结的预训练DINOv2图像编码器特征上进行规划，在完全移位条件下取得了最高成功率（0.83），但仍对表面外观敏感。我们的实验揭示了规划表征的一个重要要求：它们必须将不变的空间任务结构与外观分离开来。

title: Towards Probabilistically Safe Reinforcement Learning: Theory and Deployment on Humanoid and Aerial Robots
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables robots to acquire complex skills, but standard RL formulations do not guarantee that learned policies satisfy safety constraints, which limits their use in safety-critical settings. Existing safe RL methods with provable guarantees typically support only restricted classes of constraints and require unbiased estimators of the objective and constraint functions, which prevents their direct integration with state-of-the-art algorithms such as proximal policy optimization (PPO). In this paper, we extend the recently introduced robust safe gradient flow-based reinforcement learning (RSGF-RL) framework to overcome these limitations. Our formulation accommodates a general class of trajectory-level safety constraints, including chance constraints such as collision avoidance with a prescribed probability, and our analysis allows for biased value and gradient estimators. We show that, with high probability, the constraint violation throughout training is bounded by the estimator bias plus a term that vanishes as the number of rollouts grows, and decays to this level if the initial policy is unsafe. We also establish the convergence properties of the iterates to approximate KKT points of the original safe RL problem. Finally, we show that RSGF-RL implemented with PPO-style estimates enables zero-shot sim-to-real deployment of whole-body control policies on a Unitree G1 humanoid and collision-free waypoint navigation on a Crazyflie drone.
tldr: This paper extends the RSGF-RL framework to handle general trajectory-level safety constraints with biased estimators, proving high-probability safety bounds and convergence to approximate KKT points, and demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid and a Crazyflie drone.
tldr_zh: 本文扩展了RSGF-RL框架，使其能够处理具有偏估计的通用轨迹级安全约束，证明了高概率安全边界和收敛到近似KKT点，并在Unitree G1人形机器人和Crazyflie无人机上实现了零样本仿真到真实部署。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）使机器人能够获取复杂技能，但标准强化学习框架并不保证所学策略满足安全约束，这限制了其在安全关键场景中的应用。现有具有可证明保证的安全强化学习方法通常仅支持受限类别的约束，并要求目标函数和约束函数具有无偏估计量，这阻碍了其与最先进算法（如近端策略优化（PPO））的直接集成。在本文中，我们扩展了最近引入的基于鲁棒安全梯度流的强化学习（RSGF-RL）框架，以克服上述局限性。我们的公式能够处理一般类别的轨迹级安全约束，包括机会约束（如按指定概率避免碰撞），并且我们的分析允许有偏的值函数和梯度估计量。我们证明，在训练过程中，约束违反量以高概率被估计偏差加上一个随轨迹采样数量增加而消失的项所界定，并且如果初始策略不安全，该违反量会衰减至这一水平。我们还建立了迭代序列收敛至原始安全强化学习问题的近似KKT点的性质。最后，我们展示了采用PPO风格估计的RSGF-RL能够在Unitree G1人形机器人上实现全身控制策略的零样本仿真到现实迁移，并在Crazyflie无人机上实现无碰撞航路点导航。

title: Remember, Replay, Adapt: Learning from Past Experience in Online Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Existing feedback-based methods for online vision-and-language navigation (VLN) primarily learn from current episode outcomes, leaving previously acquired feedback underutilized. Inspired by human episodic memory, we propose R2A, an online VLN adaptation framework that continually reuses successful and failed navigation experiences for policy learning. Specifically, Success-Failure Memory (SFM) retains successful and failed navigation episodes with acquired feedback and retrieves task-relevant experiences based on incoming instructions, enabling historical feedback to guide subsequent navigation. Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA) learns from these experiences by reinforcing successful trajectories and suppressing failed ones relative to a frozen pretrained policy, while regularizing behavioral drift. Together, these modules enable continual feedback reuse and stable policy adaptation without source-domain data or expert supervision. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks, REVERIE, R2R, and R2R-CE, and five navigation backbones demonstrate consistent performance gains. On the REVERIE validation unseen split, R2A improves DUET's SR from 46.98% to 69.84% and SPL from 33.73% to 50.98%.
tldr: R2A is an online VLN adaptation framework that reuses successful and failed navigation experiences via success-failure memory and prior-anchored adaptation, improving performance across multiple benchmarks and backbones.
tldr_zh: R2A 是一个在线 VLN 自适应框架，通过成功-失败记忆和先验锚定自适应重用成功和失败导航经验，在多个基准和骨干网络上提升了性能。
summary_zh: 现有的基于反馈的在线视觉与语言导航（VLN）方法主要从当前回合的结果中学习，未能充分利用先前获得的反馈。受人类情景记忆的启发，我们提出了R2A，一种在线VLN自适应框架，该框架持续复用成功和失败的导航经验用于策略学习。具体而言，成功-失败记忆模块（SFM）保存带有反馈的成功与失败导航回合，并根据传入指令检索任务相关的经验，使历史反馈能够指导后续导航。先验锚定自适应模块（PAA）通过相对于冻结的预训练策略强化成功轨迹并抑制失败轨迹来从这些经验中学习，同时规范行为漂移。这两个模块共同实现了持续的反馈复用和稳定的策略自适应，无需源域数据或专家监督。在REVERIE、R2R和R2R-CE三个基准以及五种导航主干上的大量实验显示了一致的性能提升。在REVERIE验证集中未见过的划分上，R2A将DUET的SR从46.98%提升至69.84%，SPL从33.73%提升至50.98%。

title: When Backdoors Can Be Switched Off: Suppression-Aware Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations, robot states, and natural-language instructions to robotic actions, but their multimodal interfaces introduce new security risks. Existing VLA backdoor attacks primarily study trigger-based activation and stealthy action manipulation, leaving conditional suppression of malicious behavior underexplored. We investigate suppression-aware backdoors, which combine conjunctive trigger activation with instruction-conditioned suppression. We instantiate this design through three variants: Cross-Modal Trigger, combining robot-state and spatially separated visual triggers; Self-Suppressing Trigger, requiring a state trigger and a [DISRUPT] instruction token for activation, with [RESTORE] token suppressing the attack; and Multi-Trigger, additionally requiring a visual trigger while retaining suppression even when physical triggers persist. We evaluate these attacks using SmolVLA on two SO-100 manipulation datasets against four baselines: State Backdoor, BadVLA, TabVLA, and SilentDrift. Self-Suppressing and Multi-Trigger reduce Isolation Forest detection from 96--98% to 1--18% and action-space l divergence by 10--14X, achieving 63--71% attack success rates with perfect clean-task performance. Experiments with OpenVLA on LIBERO further show that the attacks transfer to a 7B-parameter policy, evading STRIP and action-distribution-shift detection. Our findings establish conditional suppression as an important dimension for evaluating backdoor threats in VLA policies.
tldr: This paper introduces suppression-aware backdoor attacks on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, where malicious behavior can be activated by specific triggers but suppressed by others, significantly evading existing detection methods while maintaining clean-task performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的抑制感知后门攻击，通过特定触发条件激活恶意行为并可通过其他条件抑制，显著规避现有检测方法，且不损害正常任务性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉观察、机器人状态和自然语言指令映射为机器人动作，但其多模态接口引入了新的安全风险。现有VLA后门攻击主要研究基于触发器的激活和隐蔽动作操纵，而对恶意行为的有条件抑制尚未充分探索。我们研究了具有抑制能力的后门，其结合了合取式触发器激活与指令条件化抑制。我们通过三种变体实例化该设计：跨模态触发器，结合机器人状态与空间分离的视觉触发器；自抑制触发器，需状态触发器和[DISRUPT]指令标记进行激活，而[RESTORE]标记则抑制攻击；以及多触发器，额外需要视觉触发器，同时即使物理触发器持续存在仍保持抑制能力。我们使用SmolVLA在两个SO-100操作数据集上评估这些攻击，并与四种基线方法对比：State Backdoor、BadVLA、TabVLA和SilentDrift。自抑制触发器和多触发器将隔离森林检测率从96–98%降至1–18%，动作空间l散度降低10–14倍，攻击成功率达63–71%，同时保持完美干净任务性能。在LIBERO上使用OpenVLA进行的实验进一步表明，这些攻击可迁移至70亿参数策略，并规避STRIP和动作分布偏移检测。我们的研究确立了条件抑制作为评估VLA策略中后门威胁的重要维度。

title: The Sense Paradigm for World Models
summary: Latent world models predict the future in an embedding space rather than in pixels. An encoder trained only to predict collapses and maps every observation to the same point, so existing models add a mechanism against collapse, such as a target network, a variance penalty or a distribution penalty. These mechanisms keep the embedding from collapsing, but they leave its distances without meaning, and the model cannot tell a reversible transition from an irreversible one. We propose Sense, a single cross-entropy loss over the directed distance $d(x\to y)=\sum_i \mathrm{ReLU}(y_i-x_i)$ that replaces these mechanisms. The loss avoids collapse on its own, and since the encoder no longer needs the predictor, the predictor is fitted afterwards to fixed embeddings by plain regression. On four pixel environments, the return distance learned by Sense detects irreversible transitions with an AUC between 0.95 and 1.00, where LeWorldModel stays between 0.39 and 0.59. On TwoRoom, the navigation benchmark of LeWorldModel, planning with Sense reaches the goal in 100% of episodes against 91% for LeWorldModel. As the goal moves farther away, the planning failure rate of every baseline grows, while that of Sense stays near zero in Cup, Cliff and Sokoban and is the lowest of all methods in Pendulum.
tldr: The paper introduces Sense, a cross-entropy loss for latent world models that prevents representation collapse and learns meaningful directed distances, enabling accurate detection of irreversible transitions and improved planning in pixel environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Sense，一种用于潜在世界模型的交叉熵损失，既能避免表征坍缩，又能学习有意义的定向距离，从而在像素环境中准确检测不可逆转移并改进规划。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型在嵌入空间而非像素空间中预测未来。仅以预测为目标训练的编码器会坍缩，并将每个观测映射到同一点，因此现有模型会加入防坍缩机制，如目标网络、方差惩罚或分布惩罚。这些机制能防止嵌入坍缩，但使嵌入之间的距离失去意义，模型也无法区分可逆转换与不可逆转换。我们提出Sense方法，对方向距离 $d(x\to y)=\sum_i \mathrm{ReLU}(y_i-x_i)$ 使用单一交叉熵损失，以替代上述机制。该损失自身即可避免坍缩，且由于编码器不再需要预测器，预测器可在固定嵌入之上通过简单回归事后拟合。在四个像素环境中，Sense学习到的返回距离检测不可逆转换的AUC介于0.95至1.00之间，而LeWorldModel仅在0.39至0.59之间。在LeWorldModel的导航基准TwoRoom中，使用Sense进行规划在100%的回合中达到目标，而LeWorldModel为91%。随着目标距离变远，所有基线的规划失败率均上升，而Sense在Cup、Cliff和Sokoban中始终保持接近零的失败率，并在Pendulum中为所有方法中最低。

title: D'BEAST: Logged Bad Experiences as Explanation for Autonomous Driving Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning agents learn from mistakes, yet their decisions can be difficult to trace back to those experiences. We investigate whether a tabular agent's decisions can be explained by its bad experiences, defined as the training transitions associated with safety or task events. A fixed training log is replayed from the same initial Q-table under three conditions. FULL retains all updates, SKIP omits bad-experience updates, and NEUTRALIZE retains those updates without their event penalties. We illustrate the method on six classic Markov decision processes and evaluate it in closed-loop driving in CARLA. On the full driving task, FULL reached the goal from 33 of 40 test starts, whereas SKIP and NEUTRALIZE reached it from none, indicating that the bad experiences carry decision-relevant information. At the local level, for 47 decisions shortly before a failure of SKIP or NEUTRALIZE, removing or neutralizing a small group of bad experiences, with a median size of one, caused the trained agent to select the failing policy's action in 46 cases. For this agent, the results indicate that its decisions can be explained by its bad experiences.
tldr: This paper investigates whether the decisions of a tabular reinforcement learning agent in autonomous driving can be explained by its logged bad experiences, using ablation-style counterfactual replay in CARLA. It finds that removing or neutralizing a small set of bad experiences causes the agent to select different actions, suggesting that its decisions are explainable by those experiences.
tldr_zh: 本文研究自动驾驶中表格型强化学习智能体的决策是否可由其记录的糟糕经验解释，通过在CARLA中的反事实重放实验发现，移除或中和少量糟糕经验会改变智能体的决策，表明其决策可归因于这些经验。
summary_zh: 强化学习智能体从错误中学习，然而其决策往往难以追溯至这些经验。本研究探讨了表格型智能体的决策是否可归因于其不良经验，即与安全或任务事件相关的训练转移。在固定训练日志条件下，我们从相同的初始Q表出发，在三种情境下进行回放：FULL保留所有更新，SKIP省略不良经验更新，NEUTRALIZE保留这些更新但不包含其事件惩罚。我们在六个经典马尔可夫决策过程中展示了该方法，并在CARLA封闭环路驾驶场景中进行了评估。在完整驾驶任务中，FULL从40个测试起点中的33个成功到达目标，而SKIP和NEUTRALIZE均未能从任何起点到达目标，表明不良经验携带了与决策相关的信息。在局部层面，针对SKIP或NEUTRALIZE失效前不久的47个决策，移除或中和一小部分不良经验（中位数为一个）导致训练后的智能体在46个案例中选择了失败策略的动作。对于该智能体而言，结果表明其决策可由不良经验加以解释。

title: CRAFT: A Robot-Agent Harness with Scope-Aware Adaptation
summary: A robot may know how to move an object yet still need to learn where it belongs. When a person rejects a placement, the robot must decide whether the correction applies only to that situation or expresses a broader rule. We study this problem in CRAFT (Contextual Requirement Adaptation with Frozen Tools), a framework for learning local requirements without retraining robot skills. It records physical success separately from whether an action meets the requirement. Our scope ladder uses memory when an action has already been judged in a nearly identical situation. Elsewhere, it combines memory, explicit rules and a learner for requirements beyond those rules, weighting their predictions by how well they predicted earlier feedback. Controlled studies show gains over correction memory alone in utility, which rewards acceptable actions and charges for mistakes and questions. In camera-grounded robot simulations, the ladder asks fewer questions than language-model agents with persistent memory, but some of those agents take fewer wrong actions and succeed more often after requirements change. All execution failures and timeouts remain in the evaluation. These results support combining specific memories with broader rules, while leaving reliable adaptation to changing requirements unresolved. All evidence comes from simulation with generated requirements and simulated feedback.
tldr: CRAFT introduces a framework for robots to learn contextual requirements from feedback without retraining skills, using a scope ladder that combines memory, rules, and a learner. Simulations show it reduces questions but does not fully solve reliable adaptation to changing requirements.
tldr_zh: CRAFT提出了一种框架，使机器人无需重新训练技能即可从反馈中学习情境要求，通过结合记忆、规则和学习器的范围阶梯来减少提问，但未能完全解决需求变化时的可靠适应问题。
summary_zh: 机器人可能知道如何移动物体，但仍需学习物体应放置的位置。当人类拒绝某次放置时，机器人必须判断该纠正仅适用于当前情境，还是表达了一条更广泛的规则。我们在CRAFT（基于冻结工具的上下文需求适应）框架中研究这一问题，该框架用于在不重新训练机器人技能的情况下学习局部需求。它将物理成功与否与动作是否符合需求分别记录。我们的范围阶梯在动作已在几乎相同情境中被评判过时使用记忆；在其他情况下，它结合记忆、显式规则以及用于学习超出规则范围需求的 learner，并根据它们对先前反馈的预测效果对其预测进行加权。对照研究表明，在效用指标上，该方法优于仅依靠纠正记忆的方法——效用奖励可接受的动作，并对错误和提问进行惩罚。在基于相机的机器人仿真中，该阶梯相比具有持久记忆的语言模型智能体提问更少，但部分语言模型智能体采取的错误动作更少，且在需求变化后成功次数更多。所有执行失败和超时均包含在评估中。这些结果支持将具体记忆与更广泛规则相结合，但需求的可靠适应问题仍未解决。所有证据均来自模拟环境中的生成需求和模拟反馈。

title: From Companion to Guardian: Designing an Emergency Support System Using a Quadruped Robot for Older Adults
summary: As older adults increasingly live alone, emergency support becomes an important function for home companion robots. In Australia, demand for the care and support workforce is projected to nearly double between 2020-21 and 2049-50. Service robots such as robot dogs may support older adults by combining everyday companionship with assistance when human support is not immediately available. We present the design and implementation of a domestic companion-robot system on a Unitree Go1 quadruped platform that combines companionship with emergency awareness and response. The system uses a three-stage interaction model consisting of companion, danger-awareness, and emergency modes. A rule-based escalation policy combines signs detected from visual and speech input to determine the current risk level and adjust how long the robot waits for the user to confirm safety before entering emergency mode. Additional detected signs can shorten this waiting time. Users can confirm safety, request immediate help, stop robot motion, or reset the system. We verified the implemented decision rules and escalation timing through 105 automated trials and 25 staged physical trials. Additional visual evidence shortened the waiting time, and the system entered emergency mode when the waiting time ended without confirmation.
tldr: This paper presents the design and implementation of a domestic companion-robot system on a Unitree Go1 quadruped, integrating companionship with emergency awareness and response for older adults. It uses a three-stage interaction model and rule-based escalation policy, verified through automated and physical trials.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于Unitree Go1四足机器人的居家伴侣机器人系统，将陪伴与紧急情况感知和响应相结合，面向独居老年人。系统采用三阶段交互模型和基于规则的升级策略，并通过自动化和物理试验进行了验证。
summary_zh: 随着老年人独居现象日益普遍，应急支持成为家庭陪伴机器人的一项重要功能。在澳大利亚，预计2020-21年至2049-50年间，护理与支持劳动力的需求将近乎翻倍。诸如机器狗等服务机器人，可通过将日常陪伴与在人类支持不可及时提供援助相结合，来支持老年人。我们展示了一个基于Unitree Go1四足平台的家用陪伴机器人系统的设计与实现，该系统将陪伴功能与应急感知和响应相结合。该系统采用三阶段交互模型，包括陪伴模式、危险感知模式和应急模式。一种基于规则的升级策略结合了从视觉和语音输入中检测到的迹象，以确定当前风险水平，并调整机器人在进入应急模式前等待用户确认安全的时间。额外检测到的迹象可缩短这一等待时间。用户可以确认安全、请求立即帮助、停止机器人运动或重置系统。我们通过105次自动化试验和25次分阶段物理试验验证了所实施的决策规则和升级时序。额外的视觉证据缩短了等待时间，且当等待时间结束而用户未确认时，系统进入应急模式。

title: EasyNav: A Modular Architecture for Real-Time Navigation Across Heterogeneous Robot Environments
summary: Most robot navigation stacks implicitly bind mapping, localization, planning, and control to specific representations and data flows, yielding architectures hard to extend, compare experimentally, or reason about end-to-end timing. This is critical in heterogeneous scenarios, where multiple spatial representations, sensing modalities, and coordinate frames coexist and evolve at different rates. This paper presents a navigation architecture centered on an explicit, shared navigation state that serves as the sole interaction interface between modular components. Constraining mapping, localization, planning, and control to operate over this shared state enables interchangeable, representation-agnostic pipelines under explicit compatibility and timing contracts. We realize this architecture as EasyNav, an open source ROS 2 framework, and validate it through real-robot experiments, including indoor navigation with laser sensing and large-scale indoor-outdoor navigation with GPS and 3D LiDAR across multi-level routes. Compared with Nav2 under matched conditions, EasyNav reduces reaction latency from 377 to 33 ms indoors and from 71 to 8 ms outdoors, while also using less CPU and memory.
